description: This file defines the ProximityKeyDetector class, which extends KeyDetector and is responsible for detecting nearby keys on a keyboard layout based on touch input, including calculating distances and identifying the closest keys.

classes.name: ProximityKeyDetector
classes.description: A class that detects proximity of keys on a keyboard layout based on touch input, extending KeyDetector.
